analysis_notes.notes:
Gap analysis of LM2/55.

1. DATASET COVERAGE: There are zero bechina edges in torahData.js for reference 1055. The dataset has no entries for this Torah at all. There are no unassigned dataset nodes.

2. SOURCE TEXT BECHINA SCAN: The source text (torah_55.txt) consists of a single paragraph — one compound sentence. The full text is:

   'רֶוַח הָעוֹלָם הַזֶּה אֵין לְשַׁעֵר, דְּהַיְנוּ מַה שֶּׁהָאָדָם יָכוֹל לְהַרְוִיחַ בְּזֶה הָעוֹלָם, וְאֵין צָרִיךְ עַל זֶה הוֹצָאוֹת מִשֶּׁלּוֹ, שֶׁקּוֹרִין אוֹישׂ־לַאג, רַק מִמַּה שֶּׁהֵכִין לְפָנָיו הַבּוֹרֵא יִתְבָּרַךְ, יָכוֹל לְהַרְחִיב יָדוֹ וּלְהַרְוִיחַ הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד. עַיִן לֹא רָאָתָה וְכוּ.'

   The text does not use the word 'בְּחִינַת' or any equivalent bechina-marking language at any point. It makes no statement of the form 'X is an aspect/bechina of Y.' It is a single theological-moral assertion: the spiritual gain available in this world from God's preparation is immeasurable and free — 'eye has not seen' (Yeshayahu 64:3).

3. CONCEPTS PRESENT IN SOURCE TEXT: Three conceptual elements appear:

   (a) רֶוַח הָעוֹלָם הַזֶּה — the profit/gain of this world. This is the teaching's subject, not one side of a bechina equation.

   (b) מַה שֶּׁהֵכִין לְפָנָיו הַבּוֹרֵא יִתְבָּרַךְ — what the Creator has prepared before a person. This is the source of the gain described — a causal/theological claim (God prepared X, therefore gain is available), not a bechina equation.

   (c) עַיִן לֹא רָאָתָה — 'eye has not seen' (Yeshayahu 64:3), cited as a prooftext for the immensity of the available gain. This is exegetical support, not a bechina concept node.

   None of these three elements form bechina pairs with each other or with any other concept in the text. The teaching has no bechina structure to capture.

4. EVALUATION: Torah LM2/55 is among the most minimal texts in Likutay Moharan — a one-sentence aphorism without explicit conceptual equations. Its absence from the dataset is accurate and correct. No additions can be made: there are no bechina relationships in the text to add, and no dataset nodes are unassigned.
